shape_note: In the four fact sections every number sits beside `evidence_ids[<field>]`, the id of a verified record under `evidence`; a text field holds words taken from its quote; `qualifiers` keeps Delta's hedge words (approximately, less than). Blocks named derived, guidance_vs_actual and arithmetic_checks are computed from those facts.
fuel_price_note: fuel_price_gaap_usd_gal is aircraft fuel expense per gallon as reported. fuel_price_adj_usd_gal removes mark-to-market adjustments and settlements on Monroe hedges (Note A) and is the price Delta describes together with its refinery benefit. Guidance assumes an all-in price including the refinery benefit and is footnoted as non-GAAP, so it corresponds to the adjusted price.

management_explanation.speaker: Ed Bastian, chief executive officer
management_explanation.summary: The full-year outlook is framed as absorbing a large increase in fuel cost.
management_explanation.quote: For the full year, we expect to generate a pre-tax profit of roughly $4.5 billion, absorbing a $6 billion increase in fuel costs.

management_explanation.speaker: Erik Snell, chief financial officer
management_explanation.summary: Fuel cost more than the July guidance assumed. It is the only gap to guidance the release puts a number on.
management_explanation.quote: Delta delivered earnings of $1.72 per share in the September quarter, in line with last year while absorbing more than $500 million of higher fuel costs compared to our guidance in early July.

management_explanation.speaker: Joe Esposito, chief commercial officer
management_explanation.summary: Revenue growth on flat capacity is attributed to demand and yield, described as covering higher costs.
management_explanation.quote: September quarter revenue grew approximately 16 percent over prior year, on flat capacity, driven by broad demand strength and healthy yield growth as we cover higher costs and manage the business for margins

management_explanation.speaker: release text
management_explanation.summary: Unit revenue growth accelerated from the June quarter.
management_explanation.quote: Adjusted total unit revenue (TRASM) grew 15 percent over prior year, accelerating 3 points from the prior quarter.

management_explanation.speaker: Erik Snell, chief financial officer
management_explanation.summary: Non-fuel unit cost rose on capacity below plan, partly from summer storms.
management_explanation.quote: September quarter non-fuel unit costs increased 7.3 percent over the prior year on flat capacity, driven primarily by higher crew and revenue-related costs on capacity growth that was several points below our original plan, including nearly one point of impact from summer storms.

management_explanation.speaker: release headline
management_explanation.summary: The headline presents the quarter as durability under high fuel cost.
management_explanation.quote: Strength of results and outlook demonstrate Delta’s structural durability in high fuel cost environment

management_explanation_not_stated: The October release never says guidance was missed and gives no per-share effect of the fuel overrun.
It does not split the gap to guidance between fuel, revenue and non-fuel cost.

guidance_vs_actual_sep_quarter.note: Differences of figures printed in the two releases. Arithmetic only: not a model or a forecast.

fuel_price_usd_gal.basis_note: The assumed price is all-in including the refinery benefit, so it is set against the adjusted price. The GAAP price is shown for reference only.

fuel_cost_above_guidance.tax_rate_note: adjusted income tax over adjusted pre-tax income of the same quarter; the release prints no tax rate

derived.note: Ratios of printed figures; Delta does not print them.

arithmetic_checks.tolerance_rule: half a unit of the stated figure's last printed digit, plus the spread of the formula over the rounding intervals of its inputs
